Amar-Nīti.gloss: A merchant-devotee in the Periya Purāṇam, remembered for the balance on which a single loincloth outweighed his wealth.

Sundarar.gloss: Tamil Śaiva poet-saint whose first hymn begins at Tiruvennainallur after the old-man-and-deed episode.

Appar.gloss: Tirunāvukkaracar, the Tamil Śaiva poet-saint repeatedly remembered with an uzhavaram in his hand.

Tirumaṅgai Āḻvār.gloss: One of the Āḻvārs; his own Periya Tirumoḻi remembers a transformed past, while later hagiography tells the highway-robbery conversion scene.

Kulaśēkhara Āḻvār.gloss: King-poet of the Perumāḷ Tirumoḻi, remembered in later Śrīvaiṣṇava hagiography as trying to send his army into the Rāmāyaṇa.
